Hi Logan, thanks for reaching out — happy to help with that. Yes. After a Full Service — Standard, we re-test water resistance to 100m, and Full Service — Premium includes all Standard items as well, so that water resistance test is included there too. Hi Dylan, thanks for reaching out — happy to help with that. Yes, we offer caseback engraving.

For standard Roman/Latin script, you can fit up to 60 characters total:
- Up to 20 characters: SGD 25
- 21 to 40 characters: SGD 40
- Beyond 40 characters: SGD 1.5 per additional character, up to a maximum of 60 characters

If you’re looking at Chinese, Japanese, Korean, or Arabic script, the limit is up to 15 characters at SGD 3.0 per character.

Source: kb/pricing/engraving-rate-card.md

Hi Scarlett, thanks for reaching out — happy to help with that. Yes, it is possible to engrave a small logo or symbol on the caseback, not just text. Custom logo/symbol engraving is available at SGD 60, and you would need to supply the artwork as a vector file in .ai or .svg format. Please note that approval is required before proceeding. Hi Nathan, thanks for reaching out — happy to help with that. Yes, a Full Service is recommended every 3–5 years, so at 3 years your watch is within the usual servicing window.

Here’s what is included in the Full Service — Standard at SGD 160:
- full movement disassembly
- ultrasonic cleaning
- lubrication
- regulation
- water resistance test (100m)
- light case polish
- new gaskets

Turnaround is 14–21 days.

If you’re considering the Premium option at SGD 220, that includes everything in the Standard service, plus:
- deep case polish
- crystal replacement if scratched
- new crown and pushers if worn
- 12-month service warranty

Since you mentioned the watch is running slightly slow, a Regulation Service may also be relevant if your watch has an automatic movement. That service is SGD 85, takes 7–10 days, and includes movement cleaning, regulation to +/-5 s/day, and a timing machine report.

Source: kb/pricing/servicing-rate-card.md
